---
title: "(S,D) lean-Gaussian vs BVP vs market — 2026 walk-forward"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  devtools::load_all(here::here(), quiet = TRUE)
  library(dplyr)
  library(arrow)
  library(ggplot2)
})
wf_dir <- here::here("data", "backtest", "walkforward")

load_bets <- function(model) {
  out <- list()
  for (sex in c("male", "female")) {
    f <- file.path(wf_dir, paste0("bets_", model, "_", sex, ".parquet"))
    if (!file.exists(f)) next
    b <- read_parquet(f)
    if (nrow(b) == 0L) next
    b$sport <- "football"
    b$country <- "iceland"
    b$sex <- sex
    b$model <- model
    out[[sex]] <- b
  }
  if (length(out) == 0L) tibble::tibble() else bind_rows(out)
}

bets <- bind_rows(load_bets("bvp"), load_bets("sd"))
have_data <- nrow(bets) > 0L
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr have_data
skill <- bets |>
  group_by(model) |>
  group_modify(~ {
    sc <- bt_devig(.x)
    if (nrow(sc) == 0L) {
      return(tibble::tibble())
    }
    s <- bt_skill(sc, by = c("sex", "market"))
    ci <- bt_skill_ci(sc, by = c("sex", "market"))
    left_join(s, ci, by = c("sex", "market"))
  }) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(sex, market, model)
knitr::kable(
  skill |> select(model, sex, market, n, n_matches, brier_skill, skill_lo, skill_hi, logloss_skill),
  digits = 4,
  caption = paste(
    "Model-vs-market skill by sex x market. brier_skill / logloss_skill > 0 beats the de-vigged line.",
    "skill_lo/hi is the match-clustered 90% CI on the BRIER skill only -- it does not bound logloss_skill."
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr have_data
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5
plt <- skill |>
  filter(!is.na(brier_skill)) |>
  ggplot(aes(market, brier_skill, fill = model)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = skill_lo, ymax = skill_hi),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~sex) +
  labs(
    title = "OOS Brier skill vs the de-vigged Lengjan line, 2026",
    subtitle = "above 0 = beats the market; bars are 90% match-clustered CIs on Brier skill",
    x = NULL, y = "Brier skill (1 - model/market)"
  )
tryCatch(plt + metill::theme_metill(), error = function(e) plt + theme_minimal())
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr (!have_data)
cat(
  "No walk-forward outputs found in", wf_dir,
  "\nRun Task 4 (scripts/0Nb_walkforward.R --model {bvp,sd} ...) first."
)
```

## Verdict — (S,D) lean-Gaussian does not promote

**Pre-registered promote rule:** the `(S,D)` model advances to Phase 2 only if its
**totals** Brier skill is ≥ 0 with a CI lower bound no worse than BVP's, per sex.

**Outcome: fails on both sexes.** Walk-forward OOS over the 2026 season (male 11
round cutoffs ≈ 148 bettable matches; female 9 ≈ 19):

- It does not beat the de-vigged Lengjan line in any (sex × market) cell, and it
  underperforms the production BVP across moneyline and spread for both sexes
  (see the pooled rows: SD male −0.039 vs BVP −0.020; SD female −0.052 vs BVP
  −0.002).
- On **totals** — the market the mean-scaled covariance targets — male is
  marginally less bad than BVP (−0.020 vs −0.037, both still below the line), and
  on **female totals it erases a real edge BVP holds** (BVP +0.110 with a CI that
  excludes 0, collapsing to SD +0.008 at the line).
- The model was clean and identifiable (PPC: `φ ≈ 0.91`, `γ ≈ 1.17` both
  data-driven, 0 divergences, EBFMI ≈ 1.0) — so the loss is the
  **discrete-vs-continuous tradeoff**, not a covariance mis-specification. This
  **replicates the April 2026 in-sample audit verdict through the OOS-market lens.**

Phase 2 (standing infrastructure) does not run. The walk-forward `--model` hook,
the second-moment diagnostic, and this report remain as reusable tooling and a
documented negative result. Production football stays on
`bivariate_poisson_no_inflation.stan`.
